mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market strength, driving positive equity returns through improved corporate earnings visibility over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.3pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% each signals robust consumer demand, triggering positive equity returns through elevated corporate revenue expectations over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 index level signals strengthening manufacturing output, driving positive equity returns through improved profit margins over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances during post-recession recovery when INDPRO exceeds 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) correlates with rising corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic cycle phase.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE declines for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that trigger Fed rate hikes, causing negative equity returns through reduced profit margins over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.3% each signals synchronized supply-side expansion, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate output and margins over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and PAYEMS both increase > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS increase > 0.3% MoM.
